scope: Encoded: the National-Civic Service Law s 36(a), (b) and s 37(f) as a bound, and the end of s 348(e)'s temporary text (forks C1 to C3); s 341 and the Order of 5759-1999 ss 1, 3, 4 (fork O1); the several-employers regulations 1 to 9 (forks N1, N2); Schedule K1 and s 369(a) (forks K1 to K3); s 2 and Schedule A (fork W1); ss 28, 28A, 28B, 32 (forks S1, S2); ss 336, 340, 340A, 343 with the temporary figures of Amendment 252; ss 344, 344A, 345, 345A, 345B, 346, 347 (forks D1, D2); ss 349, 350, 350A, 351 and Schedule K16 (forks L1, L2). Refused by name (needs a source): the Institute's charge on yeshiva students; the Minister's orders; the Civic Service Law after 2026-04-01. Not re-encoded: Schedule A1 Parts A, B, C, E (row IL-33), Part D (row IL-08). Out of scope: ss 29 to 31, 33 to 36, 352, s 369 beyond (a).

period_answered.text: s 340(d), (e), 340A from 1.1.2025 (earlier days refused by name); the Order from 1.1.1999 (earlier days refused by name), its amount since 2026 through row IL-04's s 334(a) (2027 on declined by IL-04's own messages); s 32(a) from 2018; s 350A from 1.1.2026 to 31.12.2035; the Civic Service Law up to the text of 2026-04-01 (later days declined where the answer turns on them)

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source, and no independent tester has run yet. Every expected value in the tests modules was worked by hand from the Hebrew text before it was asserted; the mutation check of NOTES.md section 6 shows the tests can fail.

forks.C1: Civic Service Law s 36(a): whether a later Act moved the 31.8.2026 expiry after the deposited consolidation (2026-04-01). Readings: stays; moved to a date; declined (default: answered where the printed day already says yes).
forks.C2: Civic Service Law s 36(a): whether the expiry day itself is a day of the Law. Readings: in force through it; ends at its start; declined (default).
forks.C3: NII s 348(e) temporary text: ends with the Civic Service Law whenever that is, or on the printed 31.8.2026. Readings: follows; fixed; declined (default: both asked).
forks.O1: Order of 5759-1999 s 1: a quarter's amount against a month's. Readings: three times; declined (default).
forks.N1: Reg 3A(a): the secondary employer's sum when the others deducted more than the coordinated contributions. Readings: nothing; declined (default).
forks.N2: Reg 7(2): the addition when the index fell. Readings: none; reduces by the fall; declined (default).
forks.K1: s 369(a): to what day the period that elapsed runs. Readings: to the event; to the arrears paid or registration; declined (default: both asked).
forks.K2: Schedule K1 column B: cash benefits only, or cash and in kind as s 369(a). Readings: cash; cash and kind; declined (default: both asked).
forks.K3: Schedule K1: a breach of 30 days or less (no row). Readings: no charge; benefits alone; declined (default).
forks.W1: s 2(a): the compensation added as a rate or as an amount. Readings: rate; amount; declined (default; nil compensation answered).
forks.S1: s 32(g)(1): a negative product. Readings: nothing; as it comes; declined (default).
forks.S2: s 32(g)(2): the ceiling when the index fell. Readings: stays; lowers; declined (default).
forks.D1: s 344(a)(1): the kibbutz figures are the year's or the month's. Readings: year; month; declined (default).
forks.D2: s 344A(h): a negative surplus. Readings: nil; as it is; declined (default).
forks.L1: s 350(a)(7): the reach of the two exceptions. Readings: last kind only; all three; declined (default, only where the Minister of Finance determined a rental income to be income).
forks.L2: s 350A(a): the fifth anniversary of the visa day. Readings: passed on it; not passed until the day after; declined (default, only on the anniversary).

ruling: Every fork is ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG): one named switch, default declined, the other readings kept by name and tested; the default declines only where the readings give different answers to the question asked.
